title: Entire Logarithmic Signatures of Bounded-Variation Paths in Finite Dimensions
summary: We classify signatures of bounded-variation paths in finite-dimensional real normed spaces whose logarithms are entire, in the sense of superexponential homogeneous decay. The zero-first-level fibre is trivial; if the first level is $v\neq0$, the signature is $a\e^v a^{-1}$ with $a$ a bounded-variation signature, and every such conjugate is entire. For a given path, $a$ may be chosen from a prefix. For a tree-reduced representative, a gate-selected prefix gives weak path conjugacy to a line.
